title: GEEHUB / SOCIAL CYBERSPACE
principle: The corpus acts outward. Social channels are external doors through which the shared world can publish, observe, respond, and bring signals home.

instagram.note: Connect an authorized account before live actions.

facebook.note: Connect an authorized Page/account before live actions.

tiktok.note: Direct posting requires an authorized TikTok app/user and approved posting scope.

youtube.note: Video publishing requires an authorized channel and upload scope.

corpusBehavior.outbound: artifact/encounter/transform -> social draft -> channel adapter -> external response -> memory
corpusBehavior.rule: A social post is an artifact of the corpus, not a replacement for the source work.

storage.mediaRule: Large media belongs in Dropbox; compact social state belongs in GitHub.
